name: openclaw-docs-i18n
description: 本仓库是 OpenClaw 官方文档的国际化翻译版本，面向全球用户提供多语言文档，让不同国家和地区的用户能够用本国语言阅读、理解和使用 OpenClaw。This repository is the internationalized translation of the official OpenClaw documentation. It provides multilingual documentation so that users around the world can read, understand, and use OpenClaw in their own language.
